trees.title: Bronze Skin
trees.identity: Take pain, make momentum. Build around impacts, Bronze equipment, or instinct.

nodes.name: Level 1 - Barbarian
nodes.effect: Bone, Steel, and Iron tags now count as a Barbarian tag.
nodes.payoff: Class materials become the stacking currency.

nodes.name: Level 2 - Barbarian
nodes.effect: Gain armor equal to your natural dice roll x {1} until you next act.

nodes.name: Bone Skin
nodes.effect: The first time you take damage each fight, gain 2 Harden.

nodes.name: Bone Temper
nodes.effect: While Harden is active, gain +{1} Armor per rank.

nodes.name: Blood Price
nodes.effect: On dealing Mace damage, heal {1} HP per rank.

nodes.name: Pain Memory
nodes.effect: Store {25}% of post-armor damage taken per rank. Your next Finisher adds it, capped at {20}% max HP per rank.

nodes.name: Wrath Unbound
nodes.effect: BONE WRATH also heals {1}% max HP per RAGE, per rank.

nodes.name: Scarred Hide
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Bludgeon
nodes.effect: ACTION: BLUDGEON (stuns).
nodes.payoff: Weapon kit expands; Bludgeon becomes an Impact hinge.

nodes.name: Concussive Crit
nodes.effect: Crit with a Mace: 35% chance to Stun for 1 turn.
nodes.payoff: Crits buy control, not only damage.

nodes.name: Venom Mace
nodes.effect: Mace hits against Poisoned enemies resolve one Poison tick and convert one stack into Acid.

nodes.name: Empty Fury
nodes.effect: +{25} STR for each empty action slot, per skill rank.
nodes.payoff: Short strips hit harder; rewards strip discipline.

nodes.name: Mace Mastery
nodes.effect: Bludgeon hits on Armor-Broken enemies bank +{25}% damage per rank onto the next strike.

nodes.name: Cull the Weak
nodes.effect: IRON CULL: +{4}% damage per CRISIS, per rank, against enemies under 25% HP.

nodes.name: Iron Will
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Puberty
nodes.effect: Rite of passage: +{1} Strength per level.
nodes.payoff: Marks the Mace path; Strength grows with your level.

nodes.name: Blood Market
nodes.effect: Armor drops have a 50% chance to be a Barbarian material (Bone / Steel / Iron).
nodes.payoff: Loot bias toward your material/class tags.

nodes.name: Might
nodes.effect: ACTION: MIGHT — +1 STR for the dungeon.
nodes.payoff: Early dungeon power spike from the strip.

nodes.name: Tribal Kinship
nodes.effect: Each equipped Bone / Steel / Iron piece adds +{1} STR per rank.

nodes.name: Gut Instinct
nodes.effect: Every 5 effective INT adds +{1} STR to Mace actions, per rank.

nodes.name: Blood Synthesis
nodes.effect: Every 20 STR adds +{1} to each RAGE / CRISIS / TRIUMPH mint, per rank.

nodes.name: Titan
nodes.effect: STR damage cap rises by {50}.

nodes.name: First Steel Age
nodes.effect: +{8}% damage per equipped Barbarian item, per skill rank.
nodes.payoff: Material count becomes a build choice.

nodes.name: Heavy Cadence
nodes.effect: +{0.5} Combo (lower combo threshold) per Barbarian tag on gear and strip, whole steps.
nodes.payoff: Tag-dense kits enter combo more often.

nodes.name: Second Steel Age
nodes.effect: Combo slot 2 gains +{0.5} extra hits per Barbarian material piece, per rank (whole hits).

nodes.name: Scrap Prefer
nodes.effect: Battle Scarred / New / Masterwork pieces: +{10}% Barbarian damage per matching piece, per skill rank.

nodes.name: Third Steel Age
nodes.effect: Combo slot 3 is {6}% faster per Barbarian material piece, per rank. Speed beyond 30% becomes Focus.

nodes.name: Steel Knuckle
nodes.effect: While Harden is active, Mace hits gain +{3}% damage per rank.

nodes.name: Crest of Triumph
nodes.effect: STEEL CREST grants {0.5} Fortify per TRIUMPH, per rank.

nodes.name: Tempered Edge
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Living Alloy
nodes.effect: Harden and Fortify stacks count as Bronze items. A critical may consume one stack to repeat the current slot.

trees.title: Iron Discipline
trees.identity: Control the fight by converting defense and clean sequences into tempo.

nodes.name: Level 1 - Warrior
nodes.effect: Bronze, Gold, and Mithril tags now count as a Warrior tag.
nodes.payoff: Class materials become the stacking currency.

nodes.name: First Formation
nodes.effect: +{8}% speed per equipped Warrior item, per skill rank.

nodes.name: Level 2 - Warrior
nodes.effect: Your natural dice roll x {1} becomes +% speed on your next action.

nodes.name: Drill Cadence
nodes.effect: +{0.5} Combo (lower combo threshold) per Warrior tag on gear and strip, whole steps.
nodes.payoff: Tag-dense kits enter combo more often.

nodes.name: Metronome
nodes.effect: Combo slot 2 Sword hits gain +{4}% action speed per rank.

nodes.name: Cadence Keeper
nodes.effect: Alternating actions above and below base speed grants +{1} Focus per rank.

nodes.name: Flow State
nodes.effect: Three different actions connect without a miss: gain one reroll and exploding dice on the next action.

nodes.name: War Drum
nodes.effect: DRUM CUT: +{2}% speed per BEAT, per rank.

nodes.name: Drillmaster
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Riposte
nodes.effect: After taking a hit, your next Sword action gains Pierce for {1} turn per rank; if armor absorbed the hit it also gains {1} extra hit per rank.
nodes.payoff: Every hit taken sets up the answer.

nodes.name: Guard Duty
nodes.effect: After armor absorbs any damage, your next hit gains +{5}% damage per rank.

nodes.name: Shield Geometry
nodes.effect: When armor reduces a hit to zero, Expose the attacker and jump to your first Sword action.

nodes.name: Phalanx
nodes.effect: While Fortify is active, Sword hits gain +{2}% damage per rank.

nodes.name: Mobile Bulwark
nodes.effect: Every two Sword connects grant +{1} Fortify per rank.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.effect: Ending a combo without missing heals {8}% max HP per rank and converts leftover Focus into Fortify.

nodes.name: Anchor
nodes.effect: GOLD ANCHOR slows the enemy {3}% per DRAG, per rank (max 50%).

nodes.name: Gilded Guard
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Commission
nodes.effect: Rite of passage: +{15} Agility.
nodes.payoff: Marks the Sword path; baseline tempo before tag engines.

nodes.name: Muster Hall
nodes.effect: Armor drops have a 50% chance to be a Warrior material (Bronze / Gold / Mithril).

nodes.name: Cunning
nodes.effect: ACTION: CUNNING — +3 Agility for the dungeon.
nodes.payoff: Early dungeon tempo from the strip.

nodes.name: Martial Kinship
nodes.effect: Each equipped Bronze / Gold / Mithril piece adds +{1} AGI per rank.

nodes.name: Steady March
nodes.effect: Sword actions gain +{1} effective AGI per rank.

nodes.name: Drill Synthesis
nodes.effect: Every 20 AGI adds +{1} to each BEAT / DRAG / STREAK mint, per rank.

nodes.name: Iron Discipline
nodes.effect: Once per fight, a miss does not reset the strip; lose all Focus instead.
nodes.payoff: One miss per fight keeps the line.

nodes.name: Swift Strike
nodes.effect: Hit with a Sword: +{5} Agility for the turn, per skill rank.

nodes.name: Avenge
nodes.effect: ACTION: AVENGE (Finisher) — add Warrior tag to all actions.
nodes.payoff: Finisher refreshes the whole strip’s tag value.

nodes.name: Commander's Opening
nodes.effect: First normal hit lowers Combo threshold; a first-hit critical lowers Crit threshold instead.
nodes.payoff: The first hit sets the terms.

nodes.name: Unbroken Stride
nodes.effect: +{5} Agility for each consecutive attack (resets OnTakeHit), per skill rank.

nodes.name: Field Brief
nodes.effect: Critical hits grant +{1} Fortify per rank (2 turns).

nodes.name: Parade Dress
nodes.effect: Worn / Like New / Heirloom pieces: +{10}% Warrior damage per matching piece, per skill rank.

nodes.name: Sword Mastery
nodes.effect: Sword hits against Exposed enemies advance two slots; against Marked enemies, advance zero.

nodes.name: Mithril Flow
nodes.effect: MITHRIL FLOW grants {0.34} Focus per STREAK, per rank.

nodes.name: Unbroken Ranks
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Unbroken Line
nodes.effect: Once per fight, hold a slot when the strip would reset (+{2} roll per rank).

trees.title: Shadowcraft
trees.identity: Build delayed payoffs from marks, status conversion, failure, and exact rolls.

nodes.name: Level 1 - Rogue
nodes.effect: Glass, Obsidian, and Shadow tags now count as a Rogue tag.
nodes.payoff: Class materials become the stacking currency.

nodes.name: First Cut
nodes.effect: +{8}% damage per equipped Rogue item, per skill rank.
nodes.payoff: Material count becomes a build choice.

nodes.name: Level 2 - Rogue
nodes.effect: Your natural dice roll x {1} becomes +% damage on your next action.

nodes.name: Precision
nodes.effect: Rogue-tagged actions gain +{1} Multihit.

nodes.name: Quick Fingers
nodes.effect: When your AGI exceeds the target's, gain +{1}% damage per rank.

nodes.name: Back Channel
nodes.effect: Hits against Marked enemies gain +{3}% damage per rank.

nodes.name: Snake Eyes
nodes.effect: Natural 2 and 12 grant Loaded. At 2 Loaded, replace the next roll with 20.

nodes.name: Fragile Prefer
nodes.effect: Broken / Preowned / Perfect pieces: +{10}% Rogue damage per matching piece, per skill rank.

nodes.name: Shatter
nodes.effect: GLASS NICK applies {0.34} Vulnerability per GRAZE, per rank.

nodes.name: Hairline
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Second Chance
nodes.effect: Crit miss with a Dagger: bank one miss salvage.

nodes.name: Grease Palm
nodes.effect: Connecting on a natural roll of 7 or lower grants +{1} temporary Technique per rank.

nodes.name: Steady Hand
nodes.effect: +{5} Technique for each consecutive non-miss (resets OnTakeHit/miss), per skill rank.

nodes.name: Ghost Step
nodes.effect: After a miss, gain +{1} miss-salvage charge per rank.

nodes.name: Technical Debt
nodes.effect: Distinct action tags add Debt. Repeating a tag cashes all Debt into Expose stacks.

nodes.name: No Witnesses
nodes.effect: Killing a Marked enemy retriggers the opener and banks +{1} miss-salvage charge per rank.

nodes.name: Umbral Step
nodes.effect: UMBRA applies {0.34} Expose per SWING, per rank.

nodes.name: Shade
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Initiation
nodes.effect: Rite of passage: +{15} Technique.
nodes.payoff: Marks the Dagger path; baseline precision before tag engines.

nodes.name: Black Market
nodes.effect: Armor drops have a 50% chance to be a Rogue material (Glass / Obsidian / Shadow).

nodes.name: Concentrate
nodes.effect: ACTION: CONCENTRATE — +3 Technique for the dungeon.
nodes.payoff: Early dungeon precision from the strip.

nodes.name: Shadow Kinship
nodes.effect: Each equipped Glass / Obsidian / Shadow piece adds +{1} TEC per rank.

nodes.name: Shadowcraft
nodes.effect: Your first connected Dagger action Marks the enemy. Hitting another target moves the Mark.

nodes.name: Edge Synthesis
nodes.effect: Every 20 TEC adds +{1} to each GRAZE / SWING / TROPHY mint, per rank.

nodes.name: Perfect Aim
nodes.effect: Every 25 TEC also lowers your crit threshold by {1}.

nodes.name: Envenomed Edge
nodes.effect: Dagger hits convert one Poison stack into two Bleed; critical hits convert two.

nodes.name: Deep Cut
nodes.effect: Hits apply +{1} Bleed per rank (doubled on crit).

nodes.name: Toxin Pressure
nodes.effect: Hits against Poisoned enemies apply +{1} Bleed per rank.

nodes.name: Hemorrhage
nodes.effect: When Bleed ticks, apply Expose for one turn; if already Exposed, add Armor Break.

nodes.name: Toxic Ledger
nodes.effect: Each different DoT on the target adds +{10}% of the hit as bonus damage, per rank.

nodes.name: Dagger Mastery
nodes.effect: Multihit Dagger actions add +{1} Bleed per extra hit.

nodes.name: Trophy Hunter
nodes.effect: HEADHUNT: +{3}% damage per TROPHY, per rank.

nodes.name: Black Edge
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Perfect Crime
nodes.effect: On Marked death, copy the shortest DoT and highest debuff to the next enemy; resume after the Finisher.
nodes.payoff: The next target inherits the wounds.

trees.title: Arcane Weave
trees.identity: Compose elemental reactions, action echoes, and probability rules.

nodes.name: Level 1 - Wizard
nodes.effect: Willow, Silver, and Crystal tags now count as a Wizard tag.
nodes.payoff: Class materials become the stacking currency.

nodes.name: First Glyph
nodes.effect: +{8}% AMP per equipped Wizard item, per skill rank.

nodes.name: Wand Focus
nodes.effect: Combo with a Wand: +{5} Intelligence for the turn, per skill rank.
nodes.payoff: Combo connects convert into same-turn mind.

nodes.name: Soft Echo
nodes.effect: Spell hits bank +{2}% damage onto your next hero roll per rank.
nodes.payoff: Spells echo into the next roll.

nodes.name: Spell Memory
nodes.effect: Repeating a tag adds +{12}% AMP per rank; changing tags cashes the stack (+{12}% per stack per rank).

nodes.name: Concentrated Chaos
nodes.effect: Combo actions gain +{7}% AMP per empty strip slot.
nodes.payoff: Routing mutations become a deliberate wind-up.

nodes.name: Pure Prefer
nodes.effect: Second Hand / Cosmic pieces: +{10}% Wizard AMP per matching piece, per skill rank.

nodes.name: Wand Mastery
nodes.effect: With a Wand, every action in your strip counts as a Wizard tag.

nodes.name: Lash
nodes.effect: WILLOW LASH: +{3}% AMP per CHAIN, per rank.

nodes.name: Bent Bough
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Level 2 - Wizard
nodes.effect: Your natural dice roll x {1} becomes +% AMP on your next hit.

nodes.name: Prime Theory
nodes.effect: Natural prime faces grant Theorem. At 3 Theorems, the next non-prime roll explodes.

nodes.name: Focus Lens
nodes.effect: Spell/Wand actions gain +{1} effective TEC per rank.

nodes.name: Loaded Odds
nodes.effect: Natural rolls of 15+ grant +{1} temporary Intelligence per rank.

nodes.name: Dungeon Analysis
nodes.effect: Record the prior room's common roll band. The first roll in another band next room gains advantage.
nodes.payoff: The last room teaches the next.

nodes.name: Refraction
nodes.effect: REFRACT grants {0.5} Focus per LENS, per rank.

nodes.name: Polished Mirror
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Apprenticeship
nodes.effect: Rite of passage: +{15} Intelligence.
nodes.payoff: Marks the Wand path; baseline mind before tag engines.

nodes.name: Reagent Market
nodes.effect: Armor drops have a 50% chance to be a Wizard material (Willow / Silver / Crystal).

nodes.name: Read Book
nodes.effect: ACTION: READ BOOK — +3 Intelligence for the dungeon.
nodes.payoff: Early dungeon mind from the strip.

nodes.name: Arcane Kinship
nodes.effect: Each equipped Willow / Silver / Crystal piece adds +{1} INT per rank.

nodes.name: Arcane Weave
nodes.effect: Wand actions gain +{2}% AMP per 10 INT, per rank.

nodes.name: Weave Synthesis
nodes.effect: Every 20 INT adds +{1} to each CHAIN / LENS / CONTACT mint, per rank.

nodes.name: Archmage
nodes.effect: INT's bonus to your status durations gains +{100}%.

nodes.name: Mana Bleed
nodes.effect: Spell/Wand hits restore {1} HP per rank.

nodes.name: Kindle
nodes.effect: Burn on a Poisoned enemy consumes one Poison to add Acid and +1 Burn.

nodes.name: Sigil Burn
nodes.effect: Hits against Burning enemies gain +{3}% damage per rank.

nodes.name: Thermal Shock
nodes.effect: Slow on Burning consumes both to Stun; Burn on Slowed instead adds Vulnerability.

nodes.name: Slot Mind
nodes.effect: +{5} INT per current action slot (resets OnTakeHit), per skill rank.
nodes.payoff: Deep strips amplify Intelligence until interrupted.

nodes.name: Catalyst
nodes.effect: Hits on enemies with Acid armor loss also add {1} Burn.

nodes.name: Resonance
nodes.effect: RESONATE: +{2}% damage per CONTACT, per rank.

nodes.name: Clear Facet
nodes.effect: +1% damage per rank on hit.

nodes.name: Grand Equation
nodes.effect: Once per combo, natural roll + strip slot = 21 retriggers the opener with current elemental statuses.

trees.title: Warbrute
trees.identity: Barbarian + Warrior: Body (STR + AGI) and Warbrute tags.

nodes.name: Warbrute
nodes.effect: Opens with 10 Barbarian and 10 Warrior points. Each hybrid rank costs half a point from each class.
nodes.payoff: Barbarian and Warrior become one path.

nodes.name: Body
nodes.effect: Body = STR + AGI. Body becomes your primary attribute.

nodes.name: Warbrute Material
nodes.effect: Barbarian and Warrior tags (materials included) count as Warbrute tags, and each tree's Barbarian / Warrior bonuses count the other class's tags and materials.

nodes.name: Body Blow
nodes.effect: ACTION: BODY BLOW - +{25}% damage on this hit for every 10 Body, per rank.

nodes.name: Warbrute Smash
nodes.effect: ACTION: WARBRUTE SMASH - +{25}% damage on this hit for every 10 Warbrute tags, per rank.

nodes.name: Body Surge
nodes.effect: +{1} Body for every connect (dice roll) this fight, per rank.
nodes.payoff: Body builds as the fight goes on.

nodes.name: Warbrute Momentum
nodes.effect: +{1} Warbrute tag for every connect (dice roll) this fight, per rank.
nodes.payoff: Warbrute tags build as the fight goes on.
